messages:
ben: Ugh running the node quickstart and my first call is a 403 with body: {"error":"workspace_provisioning_required", "detail":"enable_billing"}. Fresh invite to a workspace. Any ideas?
Alice: Hi @ben, can you paste the exact curl or SDK snippet you ran (token sanitized) and the workspace id if available? Which quickstart variant did you use?
ben: Using README node quickstart. curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"hello"}'
Alice: That error normally means the org hasn't completed billing setup. Did you accept an invite into an existing org or create a new one?
ben: Accepted invite to our team org. I don't see a billing page in the console though, might be a permission thing.
emma: We recently added a backend flag for invite-created orgs which marks them as "provisioning" until the owner finishes setup. There's a race where provisioning comes back from the API as workspace_provisioning_required instead of billing_required.
carla: From billing side: if there's no payment method and no trial credits, API access is gated. We should have surfaced a billing CTA. Can you share the workspace id so I can check?
ben: Sent in DM: ws-1bc9d4.
Alice: Short workaround: create a personal sandbox workspace via Console > Create workspace (this auto-grants trial credits). Then set RW_WORKSPACE to that sandbox id or include header X-Workspace to run the quickstart against it. CLI: `rwctl workspace create --name rapid-sandbox` then `export RW_WORKSPACE=ws-...`
ben: Trying that now...
ben: Nice — now streaming tokens, got a 200! First successful call using sandbox. :tada:
emma: Filing follow-ups to improve the UX: console should show a billing CTA on invite-created orgs and the API error should be unified to billing_required.
carla: I checked ws-1bc9d4 — owner hasn't added payment method. Sent automated email to owner to finish billing and temporarily enabled a team flag to allow members to use sandboxes.
Alice: Created DE-742 (console CTA) and DE-743 (error mapping). Adding quickstart README note: if you see workspace_provisioning_required, create a sandbox workspace or ask owner to add billing.
ben: Thanks all, confusing for new users but workaround helped. Closing my local follow-ups.
dino-bot: [ticket created] DE-742 DE-743 linked to ticket #43890, assigned to emma and Alice.
